channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Fort Bend plastic surgeon's license suspended after accusations of performing surgery while drunk
item.description: The Texas Medical Board suspended Dr. Azul Jaffer's license following allegations he performed procedures while drunk. Staff found liquor hidden in his clinic.

item.title: Katy man's viral TikTok video transforms Rosenberg jerky business with 33 million views
item.description: A Rosenberg woman's beef jerky business has been overwhelmed with orders after a Katy man's social media video went viral, generating more than 33 million views on TikTok.

item.title: Kenneth Cannata Appointed to Fort Bend County Justice of Peace Precinct 3, Place 2
item.description: Fort Bend County Commissioners Court on Thursday approved the creation of a second Justice of the Peace position for Precinct 3 and unanimously appointed Kenneth Cannata to fill the role of judge.

item.title: Bonin, Taylor make their case at candidate forum
item.description: Candidates Cara Bonin and Paula Taylor vowed Thursday to make flood mitigation their top priority if elected to the Katy City Council in the Jan. 31 special election.

item.title: Rooftop SWAT standoff at Greenhouse Road Chick-fil-A
item.description: A wild Friday morning scene unfolded at a Katy-area Chick-fil-A when a man scrambled onto the restaurant's roof, hurled objects at deputies below and launched into a profanity-laced tirade.

item.title: Obituary: Legendary Katy High School Football Coach Mike Johnston
item.description: Legendary Katy High School football coach Mike Johnston, who led the Tigers to three state championships and over 200 victories during his 21-year tenure, has died at 78. Services scheduled for Jan. 15-16.

item.title: Katy's original Landry's restaurant closes after 45 years; launched Fertitta empire
item.description: The Katy restaurant that launched Tilman Fertitta's multibillion-dollar hospitality empire has closed after 45 years of operation.

item.title: Two found dead in Katy home; children heard gunshots, Harris County deputies say
item.description: Two people were found dead from apparent gunshot wounds in a Katy-area home early Monday morning after the couple's adult children heard gunfire, according to the Harris County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: Nine Katy ISD Dancers Named Texas All-State Performers
item.description: Nine Katy Independent School District dancers have been named Texas Dance Educators Association All-State Dancers, one of the highest honors in Texas dance education.

item.title: Faith, football, and red suspenders: Mike Johnston remembered by colleagues and Katy leaders
item.description: Former Katy High School football coach Mike Johnston is being remembered by colleagues and Katy leaders as a man of faith who built character in the teens he coached and shaped...
